name: Kawasaki Versys-X 300
engine: 296 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Kawasaki's small adventure bike, built on the Ninja 300 engine. Some 2017 bikes had a tail light recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2017 Versys-X 300s are in recall 17V465 for a loose tail/brake light socket.
A-002.reason: Without a brake light you are hard to see. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Tail/brake light socket can come loose and let the bulb fall out.
